# MongoDB — MongoDB for Startups

Atlas credits and Voyage AI tokens delivered as a promo code, in four stage-based tiers (Inspire, Grow, Innovate, Scale). No credit figure is published for any tier.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Status** | Open - the vendor publishes no amount |
| **Verification** | Verified — A human opened the official page and confirmed this claim. |
| **Last verified** | 2026-09-16 by [@tayyabakmal1](https://github.com/tayyabakmal1) |
| **Category** | [🗄️ Databases](../categories/databases.md) |

| | |
|---|---|
| **Type** | credit |
| **Amount** | The vendor publishes no figure |
| **Duration** | 12 months |
| **Expiry** | Startups have 12 months to activate their promo code. Once activated, startups have 12 months to use your Atlas credits. Extensions are considered case-by-case. |

### Tiers

Each tier has its own eligibility. A headline figure is usually the top tier, not
what a typical applicant receives.

| Tier | Amount | The vendor's wording | Gate |
|---|---|---|---|
| Inspire | — | Inspire For bootstrapped startups Kickstart your journey with baseline credits to validate your idea and bring your product to life. | A partner improves the offer, but is not required |
| Grow | — | Grow For early-funded startups Access expanded credits and hands-on technical support to help you strengthen your foundation and accelerate early growth. | A partner improves the offer, but is not required |
| Innovate | — | Innovate For rising VC-backed startups Unlock additional credits and access to expanded expertise to accelerate product innovation and adoption. | A partner improves the offer, but is not required |
| Scale | — | Scale For rapidly scaling startups Receive maximum credits, priority support, and expert guidance to help your startup scale globally. | A partner improves the offer, but is not required |

### Not covered

- development shops and agencies
- startups previously accepted into the MongoDB for Startups program

> **Stacking:** Preferred route is a referral: "We work closely with VCs, accelerators, and incubators. Please ask your VC or accelerator partner to refer you." Direct application is still available: "If you are not involved with a VC, accelerator, or incubator, please apply above on this page."
